title: Read an explicitly selected prepared task candidate without mutation
outcome: Read an explicitly selected prepared task candidate without mutation
acceptance: A public typed read_prepared API binds the requested operation, candidate destination, project and export profile, requires a completed matching journal generation and byte-identical retained/destination documents, returns exact raw documents with typed producer/cut/operation/profile and note/activity omission provenance, preserves retained structural disclosure semantics, and neither reserializes nor captures SQLite.

The reader uses bounded no-follow retained handles and refuses incomplete, pending, unknown, malformed, divergent, linked or reparse-point inputs without creating, deleting, changing or locking files; independently testable owned fixtures verify successful and failed reads preserve every input byte and entry.
No Git, CLI enablement, SQLite row/schema/projection or remote relay change is introduced; any contrary durable-store requirement is presented to Greg before coding.

completion.summary: Delivered the additive typed read_prepared library API with exact retained/destination bytes, structural disclosure semantics and provenance, bounded no-follow refusal with preservation fixtures, and source/shipped documentation. Landed and installed the exact validated tree; no durable store conversion or restart required.
